---
name: Song Compatibility Issue
about: Report an issue with an .nbs or .mid file not playing or importing correctly
title: "[SONG] "
labels: ["compatibility", "song-format"]
assignees: []
---

### Song Information
- **File Format:** [.nbs (OpenNBS) / .mid (MIDI)]
- **NBS Version (if known):** [e.g. Classic v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5]
- **Original Source / Creator:** [e.g. Community download, export from another software]

### Description of the Issue
What went wrong when importing or playing this song? (e.g. *tempo too fast, missing instruments, note out of range, layer volume not preserved*)

### Expected Behavior
What should the song sound like or how should it import?

### Problematic File
If you are able to share the `.nbs` or `.mid` file, please drag and drop it here (or zip it) so we can reproduce and fix the compatibility bug.
